name: Fernando Pailhe
summary: Mobile Engineer with 5+ years building and rescuing production apps in React Native, TypeScript and Kotlin. As Developer and Functional Analyst on Techint's internal offline-first app (EQM), I restored release continuity, built a 2,000+ test suite and migrated the full core from JavaScript to TypeScript with AI agents in about a month, with zero regressions. I work agent-first: I design the context (rules, skills, knowledge bases) and the roles (planner, builder, reviewer) that make AI-assisted development reliable, using GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, Devin and Claude Code — most recently to launch Tune-Up solo. A decade in audiovisual production gave me a strong product and UX eye and the habit of seeing work through end to end.
